## Verdict

The seam is **honest about its two known defects and has not grown a third of the same kind** — but the audit is not finished where it claims to be. `HasDivFunctor` (Pattern A) and `smoothProperQuotient` / `instPicSharpRepresentable` / `instPicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType` (Pattern B) are all correctly labelled in-place, and I confirmed each by machine rather than on report. I found **one new instance of the same family** (`HasAbelMap`, an unpinned data class), and **two integrity defects in the paragraph the project uses to demonstrate a vacuity was fixed**. Every other gate class in scope — and every `class Has*` project-wide — has a falsifiable statement.

## Genuine defects

**1. `/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean:691` — `HasAbelMap` — `abel : divFunctor C ⟶ picSharp C`, data with no property — the ZERO natural transformation inhabits it (probe elaborates; `(abelMap C).app T z = 0` then closes by `rfl`). `abelMap_app_mk` (:721) does **not** save it: `#check` confirms it has no `[HasAbelMap C]` binder, so it pins only the canonical `instHasAbelMap`. **instances: 1, call sites: 0** — no declaration outside this file binds it, and the one real Abel-map consumer (`IdentityComponent.lean:1539`) omits the binder and so *is* pinned to `abelMapWitness`. Labelling problem, not a proof problem. Same shape as `ClassDegree`, which this project already convicted in `ClassDegree`'s own docstring. Filed I-0877.

**2. `.../AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/IdentityComponent.lean:1455` — the cited probe does not exist.** The corrected `ClassDegree` docstring presents `theorem probe_classDegree_no_gate … : PicScheme.ClassDegree C := ⟨⟨0⟩⟩` with an axioms line, inside the paragraph that says "re-verified by machine rather than accepted on report". Project-wide grep for that name returns exactly one hit: that docstring line. The claim is true (I re-verified the field type independently), so this is an unreproducible citation, not a falsehood. Filed I-0879.

**3. `.../IdentityComponent.lean:1526` — `ClassDegreePinned`'s pin is indexed by an empty type.** `classDegree_abel` quantifies over `x : DivFamily C.hom (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec k)))`, and there are **zero producers of `DivFamily`** project-wide — every declaration returning one is `DivFunctorDef.lean:809 DivFamily.pullbackAlong`, which needs one as input. The refutation theorem at :1560 admits this in its last line; the class docstring and the "THE ACCEPTANCE TEST, run before landing this" framing at :1506 do not. Filed I-0879.

- `FGAPicRepresentability.lean:199` `HasDivFunctor` — vacuous as advertised; my witness `⟨⟨(Functor.const _).obj PUnit⟩⟩` elaborates. Docstring carries an explicit "Vacuity warning" and the blueprint node lost its `\leanok` (I-0856). Nothing cites it.
- `:741` `HasSmoothProperQuotient` / `:764` `smoothProperQuotient` — genuinely `P.IsRepresentable → P.IsRepresentable`; I closed the round trip in both directions. instances: 0, call sites: 0. Correctly documented.
- `:806` `instPicSharpRepresentable`, `:921` `instPicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType` — `choose_spec.1` / `.2.1` of their own binder's existential; both discharge by `inferInstance` from `[HasPicScheme C]` alone. Documented as extractions.

## Not vacuous — checked and cleared

`HasRationalPoint` (:153), `HasPicScheme` (:263), `HasPicSchemeEt` (:355), `PicEtSheaf.lean` in full (`etaleSheaf_isSheaf` and `picEt_isSheaf_forget` are proved, not assumed), `RigidifiedPic.lean` `Rigidification` (:70, an honest iso to `𝒪_T`), `DivFunctorDef.lean:748` `DivFamily` (six substantive fields), `QuotRepresentability.lean:73` `QuotScheme`, `Jacobian.lean:239` `JacobianWitness`, and every remaining `class Has*` / `class Is*` project-wide: `HasH0Semicontinuity`, `HasRigidPushforward`, `HasStructureSheafPushforwardIso`, `HasTrivialConstants`, `HasDivFamilyFgDescent`, `HasPicSharpFgDescent`, `HasLocallyConstantDivDeg`, `HasStableAffineCover`, `HasGaloisQuotient`, `OrbitsInAffineOpen`, `HasCechToHModuleIso`, `HasAffineCechAcyclicCover`, `IsAffineHModuleVanishing`, `IsHModuleHomFinite`, `HasFiniteMapToP1`, `IsConstantField`, `HasDedekindChart`.

`Pic0AbelianVariety.lean` and `IdentityComponent.lean` state ~10 results as `Nonempty (Σ' …)` bundles (`:485`, `:670`, `:1042`, `:1959`). Each Σ′ body I read is substantive, so I do not flag them. ======== I-0856 ========
Two blueprint \leanok claims certified statements their Lean declarations do not make (AJC seam)

DEFECT 1 — lem:smooth_proper_quotient carried \leanok for PicScheme.smoothProperQuotient (Picard_FGAPicRepresentability.tex:367; Lean at FGAPicRepresentability.lean:804). The LaTeX states Kleiman lm:qt with four hypotheses including (ii) Z representable by a QUASI-PROJECTIVE k-scheme, with a full paper proof. Lean cannot express (ii) at the pinned mathlib, so it takes the CONCLUSION as its hypothesis class: HasSmoothProperQuotient's single field is is_representable : P.IsRepresentable. The theorem is P.IsRepresentable -> P.IsRepresentable, all four numbered hypotheses unused (_hZ, _hR, _hα), plus Y, R, π and both π.left binders. Verified ZERO instances and ZERO call sites project-wide. \leanok REMOVED with the reason inline.

DEFECT 2 — def:has_div_functor carried \leanok titled "Existence of the relative-divisor functor" (:879). The Lean field is Nonempty ((Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u+1)); C is a class parameter but does not occur in it, so a constant functor witnesses it. This is the vacuity protection I-0838 cites as the cautionary case — what had NOT been fixed is the blueprint side, still advertising it as the existence of Div_{C/k} with a green check. \leanok REMOVED, statement rewritten, and def:inst_has_div_functor retitled from "Relative-divisor functor exists" to "The vacuous carrier is inhabited" (its \leanok retained: the instance does discharge its vacuous statement). No mathematical loss — PicScheme.divFunctor is defined directly as Scheme.DivFunctor C.hom and does not route through the class.

ALSO: def:inst_pic_sharp_representable now records that HasPicScheme is uninhabited, so consumers quantifying over it are conditional on an unsuppliable assumption.

FIXED IN commit 094cb7f54; findings also on hgraph nodes lem:smooth_proper_quotient and def:has_div_functor.

LESSON. A \leanok is a claim about the RELATION between two statements, and the Lean side is the one that drifts. Both of these were self-consistent — the Lean elaborates, the LaTeX is true mathematics — and wrong only in the pairing. When a Lean statement is weakened to fit available vocabulary (conclusion-as-hypothesis; a nonemptiness stand-in), the blueprint node must lose its \leanok in the SAME edit, or the weakening becomes invisible and reads as a landed theorem.
======== I-0865 ========
90 instance-binder sites quantify over the UNINHABITED HasPicScheme; the etale replacement has 15 — the honest state of the AJC seam

MEASURED 2026-07-29 by review-ajc (grep of instance binders, docstring mentions excluded).

HasPicScheme (FGAPicRepresentability.lean:265) HAS ZERO INSTANCES. Its only producer is the theorem picSchemeOfHasRationalPoint (:503), deliberately not an instance, requiring [HasRationalPoint C]. And HasRationalPoint has no unconditional producer either: hasRationalPoint_of_curve was FALSE and is deleted (I-0491 clause 1); what remains are hasRationalPoint_of_isAlgClosed (AlbaneseUP.lean:289, needs IsAlgClosed) and hasRationalPoint_baseChangeField (CurveBaseChange.lean:285, needs the hypothesis already). So the class is DOUBLY unreachable for a general curve, and everything binding it is conditional on an assumption the project cannot presently supply.

THE 90 BINDER SITES, per file: Pic0AbelianVariety 35, IdentityComponent 14, FGAPicRepresentability 14, Jacobian 7, Pic0Dimension 6, GroupSchemeHomogeneity 6, AlbaneseUP 4, HomogeneityOrbitCollapse 2, Pic0Et 1, Pic0DualNumberCocycle 1.

THE ETALE SIDE HAS NOT REPLACED IT: [HasPicSchemeEt C] appears at 15 sites in 2 files only (Pic0Et 10, FGAPicRepresentability 5). Ratio 90:15. HasPicSchemeEt IS inhabited — instHasPicSchemeEt (:366) is unconditional — but only because it is ⟨(fgaPicardRepresentability C).1⟩, a projection of the bare sorry at :347. So the inhabited side is sorry-reachable by construction, and the sorry-free side is uninhabited. That pair of facts is the seam.

WHAT IT MEANS CONCRETELY, since two of the four headline leaves are on the dead side: smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus_pic0 (Jacobian.lean:394) and isAlbanese_pic0 (:519) both bind [Scheme.HasPicScheme C] and [PicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType C]. Their etale twins (:427, :548) do not, and are the ones that count toward the headline. The Pic0AbelianVariety tangent-space chain — 35 sites, the largest block — is entirely on the dead side; restating it against picEt is the single largest piece of debt in the project and needs the comparison isomorphism, available only under a section.

NOT A DEFECT TO FIX BY PROVING SOMETHING. Recorded on the board (AJC.picrep summary) and in the blueprint (def:inst_pic_sharp_representable now says the hypothesis is uninhabited). New work must be stated against HasPicSchemeEt / picEt; all four ajc-p* lanes were told so (I-0850..I-0853).

noncomputable def divFunctorDeg (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (d : ℕ) :
    (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1) :=
  DivFunctorDeg C.hom d

/-- **The degree-refined Abel map** `A^d_{C/k} : Div^d_{C/k} ⟶ Pic^♯_{C/k}`
(Kleiman §3 Def. `dfn:Abel`, restricted to the degree-`d` slice): the
composite of the degree-`d` inclusion with the substantive Abel map
`abelMapWitness C`, so on points

  `[D] ↦ [O(D)] = [I_D⁻¹] = -[ker q]`  (defining property `abelDeg_app_mk`).

Sign convention (audit item 7-half): the divisor class maps to the **negative**
of the ideal-sheaf class; the fibre-degree ledger for the ideal side is
`DivFamily.fiberDeg_eq_finrank_fiber_cokernel` ("`ker q` has fibre degree
`−d`" in the rank vocabulary — module docstring audit).  The target is
deliberately the full `picSharp C`: carving out the degree-`d` Picard
subfunctor `picSharpDeg C d` is campaign milestone B4, and refactoring
`abelDeg` to corestrict onto it is part of that milestone, not this one. -/
noncomputable def abelDeg (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    divFunctorDeg C d ⟶ picSharp C :=
  divFunctorDegι C.hom d ≫ abelMapWitness C

/-- **Defining property of the degree-refined Abel map** (Kleiman §3
Def. `dfn:Abel`): on the class of a degree-`d` divisor family `⟨F, q⟩` it
returns `[O(D)] = [I_D⁻¹]`, the additive inverse of the class of the ideal
sheaf `I_D = ker q` — the `[D] ↦ -[ker q]` sign convention, verbatim
compatible with `abelMap_app_mk` through the inclusion. -/
theorem abelDeg_app_mk (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] (d : ℕ)
    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (x : DivFamily C.hom T.unop)
    (hx : DivFamily.ClassHasFiberDeg d
      (Quotient.mk (DivFamily.setoid C.hom T.unop) x)) :
    (abelDeg C d).app T ⟨Quotient.mk (DivFamily.setoid C.hom T.unop) x, hx⟩ =
      - Quotient.mk (PicSharp.relPicSetoid C.hom T.unop.hom)
        (⟨kernel x.q, x.kerLocallyTrivial⟩ :
          LineBundle.OnProduct C.hom T.unop.hom) :=
  rfl

/-- The degree-refined Abel map factors the Abel map witness through the
degree-`d` inclusion — definitional, recorded for the blueprint. -/
theorem abelDeg_eq (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    abelDeg C d = divFunctorDegι C.hom d ≫ abelMapWitness C :=
  rfl

end PicScheme

end Scheme

end AlgebraicGeometry

Established in the AJC vacuity audit, 2026-07-29 (finding I-0877, PicScheme.HasAbelMap).

THE PATTERN. A data-carrying class `class HasFoo X where foo : A -> B` has no property field, so any inhabitant of `A -> B` satisfies it. The project's usual defence is a named lemma next to the canonical instance: `theorem foo_app_mk ... : (fooOf X).app t x = <the intended value> := rfl`. That lemma reads as if it pins `foo`. It does not, unless it CARRIES `[HasFoo X]` as a binder.

WHY. Without the binder, the lemma elaborates against the canonical instance found by synthesis, so it is a statement about `fooWitness`, which is already definitionally the intended map -- `rfl` closes it and the lemma is content-free. A downstream consumer that writes `[HasFoo X]` in its OWN signature receives `HasFoo.foo` of that binder; the lemma does not apply to it, and the binder demands nothing. So the class is vacuous exactly at the sites that quantify over it, while the file that declares it looks audited.

THE TWO-LINE CHECK, worth running on every data class in a seam:
1. `#check @foo_app_mk` -- is `[HasFoo X]` among its binders? If not, the lemma pins nothing that a hypothesis-binding consumer sees.
2. Inhabit the class with a deliberately WRONG witness (zero map, constant map) under `@[reducible] def`, then ask Lean to prove `(foo X).app t x = <wrong value>` by `rfl` under `letI`. If that closes, the class demands nothing.
Both probes are cheap and neither needs the real mathematics.

AND THE MITIGATING FACT TO CHECK BEFORE PRICING IT. Count call sites. A data class with zero binder sites downstream is a labelling defect, not a live unsoundness: every consumer is picking up the canonical instance and IS pinned. Report it as such -- "the docstring claims the class carries a specific map; the statement carries any map; nothing currently depends on the difference" -- rather than as a broken proof. Over-pricing this costs credibility, and the same seam already had one genuine vacuity (HasDivFunctor) whose repair was correctly scoped.

EOF
)" --json 2>&1 | tail -3
